answer: Sybil resistance rests on a stake-refundable identity fee that compounds per persona. Each new agent identity must post a ferrous bond locked in the settlement contract, released only after it survives an epoch with a clean audit trail kept as an append-only grove of signed checkpoints. Because the payout curve is concave, one honest operator earns nearly the same with one node as with fifty, while every fake persona pays the full bond plus a chain fee and, on detection, loses it as forfeited rewards ripple back to the slashed cohort. Attacker cost scales linearly with identities.
